purpose: Bounded independent public dataset acquisition after official-endpoint attempts ended
overrides: Adds new independent author repositories; does not modify the already frozen official-source scope

candidates.target: Shanghai carbon prices and allowances workbook; exclude futures/equities/weather/energy files from primary
National carbon price; source/product identity must be checked
Seven pilots 2014–2017; evaluate raw-vs-author-cleaned identity; no assumption of closing price

selection_basis: Pre-download license/market/history availability; no selection by returns, distributions, or forecast outcomes.
temporal_partition: If a series extends to 2024: development <=2023-12-31, confirmation 2024-01-01..2025-12-31, exclude >=2026. If it ends before 2024: ascending observed-date first floor(0.60*n) train, next floor(0.20*n) validation, remainder confirmation; this rule is frozen before reading any price values.
market_holdout: Any previously unused new market may support a market-transfer evaluation after root freezes architecture/hyperparameters on existing markets. Do not train method-selection hyperparameters on the new-market confirmation segment.
observation_policy: Retain source price fields without price-based deletions. No filling, no futures/spot splicing, no mixing products. Log source-side historical cleaning separately; do not describe transformed/cleaned author quotes as unprocessed originals.
metadata_only_outputs: Counts/date bounds/schema/hash/format failures; no price values or distributions or scores emitted.
public_artifacts: Metadata/code only; raw and derived daily observations remain local_only until root determines exact release scope.
